scientific_integrity: All three asymptotic regimes and the local eigenvalue perturbation are derived analytically; finite program checks do not certify infinite ranges. Related clipping-bias phenomena predate this result.
scientific_limitations: Noise-free, scalar, three-client equal-curvature quadratics; constant parameters. Attraction requires sufficiently small step and a sufficient feedback-retention bound. No global convergence or uniform-in-smoothing stability assertion.
title: A sharp three-regime equilibrium bias law for fixed-parameter smoothed clipping with error feedback
